title: Hatari agent console — Debugger tab
subtitle: Hatari agent console (tools/agent/hatari_gui.py) · Falcon030 running Spectral Keep · agent API :7790

items.label: Toolbar
items.text: Pause, Resume, run one frame or one second, cold reset and save a screenshot, plus a fast-forward toggle; each is one agent API call.

items.label: Live emulator screen
items.text: The /screen image polled every 150 ms at 1-3x zoom; clicking, dragging and typing on it are sent to the Atari as mouse and key input.

items.label: Debugger controls
items.text: Break, step, step over, continue and run to breakpoint, through the /debug endpoints.

items.label: Registers
items.text: 68k data and address registers, PC, SR, USP and ISP while the CPU is stopped.

items.label: Disassembly
items.text: Code at the PC, with the current instruction highlighted and branch targets resolved.

items.label: Breakpoints
items.text: Add by address, symbol or condition such as d0=$20; lists the active ones.

items.label: Debugger command
items.text: Any Hatari debugger command (here info osheader); output goes to the Console tab.

items.label: Status line
items.text: Emulator state, frame counter, PC, machine and TOS, screen mode, the GEM mouse position and the last debugger stop, from GET /status.
